rules.cache: Empty at start; only earlier successful same-condition source outputs may be recorded. Exact task, all workspace file bytes/modes, runtime context match. No historical solution import.
rules.limits: Fresh model session on misses, Sol high requested priority, 20 steps, 900 seconds, 1000000 token threshold. No retries/replacements/extensions. Heldout unopened.
rules.scope: Exact repeated development tasks only. Does not establish semantic reuse across changed repositories, real-world hit rate or general CAMI superiority.
rules.success: All eight fixed quality gates pass; both four-stage total noncached token work and end-to-end charged wall strictly lower for exact_replay. Complete telemetry and uniform complete provider tier on all model calls required. Two expected hits and two expected misses; any deviation fails admission.
rules.wall: Within-run descriptive measured pipeline time including extraction, grading, capture, cache fingerprinting, recording and materialization. Shared baseline preflight split equally. No population speed claim; no independent host-quietness proof.
